openwrt_wiki.Einleitung: The Devolo DLAN pro 1200+ WiFi ac is hardware-wise the same as the DLAN 1200+ WiFi ac (non-pro) variant. The openwrt firmware includes pro in the device name, though it can be flashed on the non-pro version as well. The DLAN pro 1200+ WiFi ac is a wall-plug device which still exposes the plug. It has Powerline capabilities, which are only useful if the proprietary firmware is added. Other than that, it includes 2 LAN ports and 2.4GHz as well as 5GHz wifi.
openwrt_wiki.OEM easy installation: Stock-Firmware "dLAN pro 1200+ WiFi ac 1.1.1": OpenWrt-Image über die Web-UI-Firmware-Update-Seite; ältere Stände oder "delos" ab 3.0.0: erst auf 1.1.1 wechseln oder TFTP; unter "delos" alternativ sysupgrade -F

TFTP.Ablauf: sysupgrade-Image; LAN-Port; Gerät mit gedrücktem Reset einschalten; warten bis Home/WiFi-LEDs einige Male rot/weiß blinken und dann an bleiben, Reset loslassen; warten bis das Rot/Weiß-Blinken endet

Switch Ports.Hinweis: LAN 2 is the interface that's placed next to the reset button.

openwrt_wiki.Powerline interface: PLC benötigt Fremd-Firmware aus dem Feed github.com/devolo/dlan-openwrt; PLC-Firmware aus Herstellerfirmware extrahieren; Variante an der Aufschrift (z. B. MT2673) oben rechts am Gerät erkennen (Beispielbild vom dLAN pro wireless 500 plus)

openwrt_git_ath79.Titel: ath79: add support for Devolo dLAN pro 1200+ WiFi ac
openwrt_git_ath79.Beschreibung: plc wifi AC2400 router/extender with 2 Ethernet ports, has a QCA7500 PLC and uses the HomePlug AV2 standard. Other than the PLC the hardware is identical to the Devolo Magic 2 WIFI.
openwrt_git_ath79.MACs: Radio1 2.4 GHz *:4c (ART 0x1002); Radio0 5 GHz *:4d (ART 0x5006); Ethernet *:4e = 2.4 GHz + 2; PLC uplink *:4f = 2.4 GHz + 3; Label MAC address is from PLC uplink
openwrt_git_ath79.Flash instruction (TFTP): PC 192.168.0.100; sysupgrade-Image als uploadfile; Reset gedrückt halten beim Einschalten, ~15 s warten; erster Start 1-2 min

gluon.PR 3334: ath79-generic: add support for DLAN (pro) 1200+ WiFi ac (maurerle, 2024-08-31): The DLAN pro 1200+ WiFi ac is the same as the DLAN 1200+ WiFi ac (non-pro). It is a wall plug device which still exposes the wall plug. The powerline functionality does not work without additional firmware, which can not be shipped due to licensing issues. Kein Power-LED, nur Haus-LED (Powerline) und WLAN-LED. Checkliste: TFTP-Installation ja, Web-Interface nein; sysupgrade ok; Reset/WPS-Taste führt in den Config-Mode; Primär-MAC wie Etikett; alle Netzports, WAN/LAN-Zuordnung geprüft; AP und 802.11s-Mesh auf allen Radios; Power-LED fehlt (daher broken)
